svg.aria-label: About Omkar, written as a Dart class: Flutter & GenAI Engineer based in Pune, India with 3.5 years shipping. Shipped Akbar Travels (flights and hotels, 1M+ downloads, iOS + Android), TryWare AI (GenAI virtual try-on, built solo) and Buggy (ride-hailing rider + driver apps). Stack: Flutter, Dart, Swift, GetX, Riverpod, Bloc; LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, AI agents, OpenAI; FastAPI, Firebase, Supabase, WebSocket, Docker; Razorpay, PhonePe, Apple Pay, Tabby, Tamara.
